caption: Night scene with classic three-point lighting: cool moonlight key, warm practical fill from a lamp or fire, subject clearly brighter than the dark surroundings

camera.notes: subject one third from frame edge, dark negative space kept on the other side

lighting.environment: night preset, exposure raised until the silhouette separates from the sky
lighting.fill: warm point light motivated by a visible prop (lamp, fire, window), intensity 20-60 near the subject
lighting.rim: faint cool rim opposite the fill

notes: the frame must stay readable: never deliver a mostly-black image; every emissive prop gets a matching point light
